entries.FS_Challenge_usage:
challenge chal [playername/id] - Challenges a player to 1v1 
 challenge accept [playername/id] - Accepts challenge by playername or id. If no player is specified accepts most recent challenge 
 challenge list - Shows a list of all challenges and their times
entries.FS_Challenge_usage_2:
challenge chal [playername/id] - challenge a player
challenge chal player - challenge current opponent
challenge accept [playername/id] - accept (newest if omitted)
challenge deny [playername/id] - decline (newest if omitted)
challenge list - incoming
challenge outlist - outgoing
challenge end - end current challenge
Or open the leaderboard: ACCEPT / DECLINE / CHALLENGE THIS PLAYER

entries.FS_TEAMCMD_ERR_01: Command requires setting & value. ex: /team set fill 0
entries.FS_TEAMHELP:
/team help                           - lists commands
/team list                             - lists teams #
/team make [name]                                               - makes a team
/team info [player|uid|team ID]                       - info about team
/team join [captain name/uid | team id]      - joins a team
/team leave                                                               - leaves a team -> if no captains exist, team is destroyed

Captain only:

/team accept [player|uid|id]                    - accepts join request by player or request id
/team reject [player|uid|id]                      - declines join request by player or request id
/team kick [player|uid|team member #]                       - kicks member from team
/team makecaptain [player|uid|team member #]    - gives player captain privileges
/team settings                                                 - lists teams settings and their values
/team set [setting] [value]                         - sets a team setting
